name: Bowl, vacuum formed
purpose: Concept of the clear bowl the fish swim in, set on the acrylic sheet over a monitor. Not released: every number is to be confirmed with the researcher before a mould is made.

requested_mm.note: From the brief: about 16 cm in diameter and 2 cm deep, vacuum formed, clear, roughly six on each monitor. Read here as the inside diameter at the rim and the inside depth; which diameter is meant is to be asked.

assumed_mm.note: Not in the brief. Chosen so that the part can be vacuum formed over a plug and six of them fit over one display; each is a question for the researcher or for whoever forms the part.

what_the_numbers_mean.wall_thickness: The formed wall, taken as uniform. The sheet is thicker before forming and thins unevenly: the model is nominal.
what_the_numbers_mean.wall_draft_deg: How far the wall leans outwards from the bowl's axis, going up. A plug needs draft to release the part.
what_the_numbers_mean.floor_corner_radius: Inside radius between the flat floor and the wall.
what_the_numbers_mean.rim_radius: Radius of the inside surface where the wall turns outwards into the flange. Not smaller than the wall thickness.
what_the_numbers_mean.flange_width: The flat rim left around the opening when the part is trimmed, measured outwards from the inside diameter at the rim.
